title: How to Create & Play The Walten Files OC in Redbean 2026
summary: Create The Walten Files OC inspired by characters like Bon, Rosemary, Jack Walten in Redbean - build your own playable character, and play out stories you write
body_markdown:
The Walten Files is an analog horror series created by Martin Walls, with a huge fanbase hooked by its creepy vibe,[distinct characters](https://the-walten-files-new.fandom.com/wiki/The_New_Walten_Files_Wiki) and the lore about Bon’s Burgers and the Walten family’s disappearance. The community has been actively hunting for a Walten Files OC Maker to create **Original Characters (OCs)** inspired by retro aesthetics, distorted hand-drawn styles and cartoon looks.


Let’s build your own The Walten Files OC, make it come alive in a story you shape yourself or write a new ending for your favorite series with **Redbean** – a free mobile sandbox and Walten Files OC Maker.

##


The Walten Files Characters, Lore and What’s Next


#


The series first aired in 2020 and picked up a much wider following on TikTok about a year later, with cosplayers and OC artists keeping the fandom active six years on and a steady stream of new Walten Files OC ideas showing up in fan art. It follows Bon’s Burgers, a family restaurant run by Bunny Smiles Incorporated (BSI), and a mystery that’s still growing.


###


Jack Walten


#


[Jack Walten Files](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/jack-walten-atpp39tqrp6z) co-founded Bunny Smiles Incorporated with Felix Kranken in the 1950s and opened Bon’s Burgers in 1974. He went missing that June, and the show has never confirmed what happened to him. His fate remains unknown. It’s the mystery the fandom keeps rebuilding theories around.


###


Rosemary Walten


#


[Rosemary Walten Files](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/rosemary-walten-jfjk3zc42fc4) is Jack’s wife and the mother of Sophie, Edward (or[Edd](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/edd-walten-hvkwtrz0yk4d) ), and[Molly](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/molly-walten-f7ti60b9aite) . She’s also BSI’s head artist, having designed the whole animatronic cast: Bon, Banny, and Sha. She disappeared on July 19th, 1974, and the latest release, *Faces of Grief* , centers on her story.


###


Felix Kranken


#


Felix Kranken co-founded BSI alongside Jack. His choices on May 2nd, 1974 set off the tragedy the series revolves around: Jack’s kids, Edd and Molly, died in a crash in Felix’s care. Some fans connect him to the mysterious “Shadow Man,” though the wiki lists that as unconfirmed.


###


Bon the Rabbit


#


[Bon Walten Files OC](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/bon-the-bunny-uh4e749fvo4z) is inspired by the blue rabbit animatronic Rosemary Walten designed as Bon’s Burgers’ lead mascot, built by technician Susan Woodings. What looks like a friendly restaurant mascot is actually the series’ main antagonist, tied to nearly every disappearance connected to BSI. He’s also the character most fan art circles back to.


###


Banny the Bunny


#


Banny is another of Rosemary’s animatronic designs, built alongside Bon as part of the Showstoppers lineup. Martin Walls has confirmed she’s a lesbian character, one of only a few canon-confirmed identities in the cast, and fans have built a small but dedicated following around her design and backstory.


###


Sha the Sheep


#


Sha is the sheep animatronic with a whiteish grey body, which becomes dirtier and more desaturated in damaged form. Rosemary considered her as her favorite design, closer to a personal “fursona” than a mascot. She’s also the character at the heart of Faces of Grief.


###


Other Characters


#


Sophie is the present-day protagonist coping with memory loss, and Susan Woodings is BSI’s lead technician. Edd and Molly, Jack and Rosemary’s other kids, and Sophie’s girlfriend Jenny Letterson round things out. Boozoo, Billy, and haunted doll Rocket cover the animatronics, while Lorenzo and Rachel Waterman headline a separate spin-off.


##


How to Make A Walten Files OC in Redbean


#


***Redbean*** is a mobile sandbox built for OC/fandom creators and roleplayers — anyone who loves turning sketches into playable characters. Not a Walten Files OC Maker tool that only generates a detailed character profile aligned with the main lore, or lets you customize your character that remains a static picture, ***Redbean*** lets you **make your own OC** or **recreate the cast** in your way, define its persona and lore, then **make it come alive as real, playable characters** in your own Walten Files universe.


Create an interactive, playable character and drop it into a real Bon’s Burgers-style pixel town within a few steps:


✨ **Create character from a photo or a sketch.** Upload a reference photo of your own design, or draw an animatronic-style OC from scratch using Redbean’s in-app tools. Either path turns into a pixel character that can move, talk, and exist in a town.


📝 **Write their persona and lore.** Decide if your Walten Files OC is another BSI animatronic, a Walten or Kranken family member, or something entirely your own creation. Give them a personality, a speaking style, and a place in the timeline. Redbean’s characters remember what you tell them, and relationships shift the more you talk to them.


🏡 **Build Bon’s Burgers as a pixel town.** Describe the restaurant, the BSI offices, or your own version of the setting in a few words, and Redbean puts the town together for you to walk around in.


🪄 **Shape the town yourself** . You can write town lore and all kinds of story arcs in “Add scene” – shaping the moments, twists and steering every choice until the ending reveals itself. The only limit is your imagination.


🌃 **Explore other players’ towns.** Visit worlds other creators have built through the Explore tab, where your Walten Files OC could end up sharing a town with characters from[Animal Hospital](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/roblox-animal-hospital-oc-maker) or any other fandom someone else has recreated, or keep your own town private and build it exactly the way you imagine Bon’s Burgers.


##


FAQ


#


###


What is Redbean? Is this an official game from The Walten Files?


#


**No, there is currently no official, playable game for *****The Walten Files******* (though the show’s allegedly inspired by the *Five Nights at Freddy’s* (FNAF) franchise), the project exists as a horror web series on YouTube.


**Redbean** is a free mobile sandbox for iOS and Android, consider it a **Walten Files OC Maker** where you create your own characters inspired by the show, build your own town, chat with locals about anything you want, and even build a different narrative for your favorite stories. **Redbean** is neither an official game nor affiliated with The Walten Files or its creator. It’s a place for fans to build their own version of characters they already love.


###


How do I build a world with my own Walten Files OC in Redbean?


#


Create your OC from a photo or a sketch, give it a persona and backstory, then place it in a pixel town (you can style it after Bon’s Burgers too). From there, you can add more characters/NPCs, set relationships between them, and explore whatever happens in town as you write yourself, or just let the town keep running even when you’re not playing.


###


Can I make animatronic OCs like Bon Walten Files in Redbean?


#


Yes. An animatronic-style OC works the same way as any other character: upload a photo of your design or sketch it in-app, then write the persona and backstory that fits your version of BSI’s lineup.


###


Can I create characters from other shows in Redbean too?


#


Yes. Besides The Walten Files OC, players use Redbean to recreate casts from shows like Animal Hospital, Catch! Teenieping, or TADC, and their unique OCs inspired by those shows. You can also build a crossover story featuring your favorite characters from different fandoms, or a dream AU town where all of them exist and play together.


###


What’s the lore in The Walten Files: Faces of Grief? Is Jack Walten still alive?


#


[The Walten Files 5: Faces of Grief](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hROQOKB2IvE) : A cinematic, stop-motion episode follows Rosemary Walten’s mental collapse after losing her family. The “Bon” entity exploits her desperation, promising reunion before brutally dismembering her—with each limb symbolizing a stage of grief—and stuffing her remains into the Sha animatronic.


Regarding Jack Walten, he has been missing since June 11th, 1974, and the series has never confirmed what happened to him. It’s the mystery most of the fandom’s theories and wiki pages are still built around.
